f(T_i | T_{i-1}), Eq. (31) for s = 1/2 and Eq. (32) for s = 1.

Source: R/background.R
conditional_pdf.Rd

Both have mean T_{i-1}: the linear drift of Eq. (29) drives every level to the temperature of the one above it.

Usage

conditional_pdf(T, T_prev, a_i, s)

Arguments

T

Sample of the reservoir temperature (or, in conditional_pdf, the value(s) at which to evaluate the density).

T_prev

Parent-level temperature, scalar or vector.

a_i

Scalar shape parameter for this level.

s

Universality class: 0.5 (gamma / stretched-exponential) or 1 (inverse-gamma / power-law).

Value

See details.
